stations.title: Day's log
stations.text: One count per crossing, in a long row

stations.title: Your methods
stations.gap: A row of numbers nobody reads

captions: Ossian's log of the day. Bridie wants to know which crossing was the busiest.
The counts are one long row on paper, and nobody adds them up or compares them.
You write methods that take the whole day as an array and read every place.
Now the last crossing, the total and the busiest come straight from the log.
Arrays, positions and length. Next, a list that grows as people join it.
